facts: Parties: Upton Retail Group plc (Buyer), Brightwater Technologies Ltd (Seller); the Company is Bellhaven Engineering Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 5 June 2026; Closing is scheduled for 19 August 2026 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 8.4 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 10% of the Purchase Price, being $8,400,000. The Purchase Price is $70,000,000 (see Section 2.1).
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 150 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 5 June 2026), either party may terminate.

Clause 14.2: either party may terminate this agreement on 30 days' notice if the other party undergoes a change of control without its prior written consent. The counterparty is Brightwater Robotics Ltd.
Disclosure against Warranty 6.3 (Material Contracts): no material contract contains a change of control provision. (No further disclosure.)
Item 5: the board noted a letter before action from Foxley Robotics Ltd threatening proceedings for approximately $2,750,000 in respect of alleged defective deliveries. Management to monitor.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 16 November 2026.
